subject: Concord: upcoming renewal — proposal for SLA elevation & capacity bump
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@concord.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Concord: upcoming renewal — options for SLA elevation & capacity bump

Hi Asha,

We’re approaching your contract renewal window in mid-February and I wanted to lay out a practical path to (1) upgrade to our Premium SLA, (2) reserve additional burst/dedicated capacity for your busiest API routes, and (3) implement a latency SLO target for mission-critical traffic.

Short version — based on last quarter’s consumption profile I recommend:
- 12-month renewal term with a dedicated capacity reservation (baseline + 30% burst pool)
- Premium SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime, 99th percentile tail latency target of <= 200ms for the dedicated pool, accelerated incident response (1h P1).
- A one-time onboarding credit to offset migration engineering (we can discuss size).

If that sounds reasonable I’ll send an SOW + SLA addendum for legal/procurement and propose a short procurement + ops alignment call next week (30 min).

Proposed times: Tue 1/20 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 1/21 11:00–11:30 PT. Which works?

Thanks — happy to tailor the terms if Concord needs a different commitment cadence.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0184

Attachments: none in this note (I'll follow with SOW draft after we pick a time).

From: Asha Menon <asha@concord.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:09:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Concord: upcoming renewal — options for SLA elevation & capacity bump

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the heads up. The high-level direction makes sense — a few clarifying questions before we do procurement:
1) Can you confirm the specific latency guarantees by percentile (p50/p95/p99) and whether the 200ms is p99 or p99.9?
2) What is the monthly cost delta for the dedicated + 30% burst pool compared to current committed baseline?
3) Is the Premium SLA only for the dedicated pool or all traffic?

Procurement also asked for a draft SOW and a redline-friendly SLA addendum to circulate. If you can share those before the call that will speed things up.

Best,
Asha Menon
Head of Platform Engineering, Concord Systems
asha@concord.ai

Attachment: Concord_Procurement_Window.xlsx (they attached their internal renewal calendar)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 09:02:05 -0800
Subject: RE: Concord renewal — need pricing + SLA wording

Logan / Monica — quick sync required. Asha wants specifics on p50/p95/p99 and the cost delta. Procurement asks for SOW + redline-friendly SLA.

Recommended (based on their profile):
- SLA scope: Premium SLA applies to the dedicated capacity pool only (we provide elevated monitoring & response for the reserved fleet). Public-hosted routes remain on standard SLA unless we explicitly migrate traffic.
- Latency targets for dedicated pool: p50 <= 40ms, p95 <= 120ms, p99 <= 200ms (these are measured at token-level per-request within the dedicated cluster).
- Availability: 99.9% for dedicated pool, with 1-hour P1 response and 4-hour remediation target for critical incidents.
- Pricing: +18% on their baseline committed monthly spend for the reservation + a $15k one-time onboarding & validation fee. Offer a 10% early-renewal credit if they sign before 2/5.

If legal wants different wording for metrics, we can push the metric definitions into the SLA addendum (SLA_Addendum_Concord.docx). I can include a concurrency bump (30% burst pool) and an option to increase capacity mid-term at a pre-negotiated rate.

Approve pricing/terms? I’ll draft paperwork and loop in procurement/legal.

—Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@concord.ai>, procurement@concord.ai
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jan 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Concord: upcoming renewal — SOW + SLA addendum (draft attached)

Hi Asha — thanks for the questions. I’ve attached two docs: (1) Concord_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf (SOW with seat counts, baseline, and reserved pool), and (2) SLA_Addendum_Concord.docx with metric definitions and measurement windows. Key callouts:

- Latency (dedicated pool): p50 <= 40ms; p95 <= 120ms; p99 <= 200ms (measured across 5-min windows, aggregated hourly).
- Availability: 99.9% monthly uptime for dedicated cluster. Credits are tiered in the addendum.
- Response: P1 triage in 1 hour (live pager), P2 triage in 4 hours.
- Pricing: +18% baseline for the reservation, $15,000 onboarding fee, 10% credit if signed by 2026-02-05.
- Term: 12 months with auto-renew; option to convert to multi-year for a deeper discount.

Can we meet Tue 1/27 10:00 PT for legal/procurement to walk the docs? If that works I’ll create a DocuSign envelope and route it.

Thanks — attaching both files.

—Ben

Attachments:
- Concord_Renewal_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF)
- SLA_Addendum_Concord.docx (DOCX)

From: Asha Menon <asha@concord.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@concord.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 13:44:18 -0800
Subject: Re: Concord: upcoming renewal — SOW + SLA addendum (draft attached)

Ben — we reviewed the SOW and the SLA addendum. Procurement approved with two small asks:
1) Move the 10% early-renewal credit deadline to 2/8 (our procurement committee has a discrete window).
2) Add a short clause allowing a one-time measurement review after 90 days to validate latency baselines.

I’ve attached the redline and we can sign once the two items are accepted. Sending the signed copy back via DocuSign after legal okays the minor edits.

Thanks,
Asha

Attachment: Concord_SOW_Redline_2026-02-02.pdf
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/EXAMPLE-DS-2345

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Concord renewal — ops onboarding checklist

Team — Concord signed the SOW (pending the small redline acceptance). Once Ben confirms we accepted the two asks, please kick off the following:
- Provision dedicated pool: baseline equivalent to current committed GPU capacity + 30% burst. Target provisioning window: 7 business days from signature.
- Create monitoring dashboards: per-route latency p50/p95/p99 + token-level compute burn.
- Add Concord to premium incident pager rotation and runbook (P1 1h triage).
- Schedule a 90-day measurement review with Concord to validate latency baselines.

Monica — you own provisioning. Marissa — please prepare runbook and reporting cadence. Ben — confirm when DocuSign completes and upload signed SOW to the deal record.

Thanks — Logan
Director, Customer Operations
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
